scope: Read-only candidate C source review, nine mocked-facade/real-local-capture controls and three independent inert source controls. No process, SDK provider, receiver, network, native or business workflow executed.

findings.evidence: Synthetic metadata callback has all six selected pins but raises PackageNotFoundError for protobuf. preflight succeeds and never queries protobuf or typing_extensions. Current worker imports SDK/encoders only after parent starts it. Safe cleanup alone does not establish selected dependencies were available.
findings.requiredCorrection: Explicit positive dependency admission after selected version checks and actual required imports, before provider construction. Parent tracks that admission independently of readiness and must never fallback after dependency/import refusal. Choose and state the finite compatible dependency boundary; exact six metadata labels alone are insufficient.

findings.evidence: Actual facade definitions with an inert Popen port: startup OSError plus group-termination OSError attempts both pipe closes and wait, sets original primary.cleanup_failed, then emits a new DiagnosticsError without that marker or a positive closure result. No child is spawned in this control.
findings.requiredCorrection: Public fixed-message OtelStartupError with immutable cleanup_complete and dependency_admitted exact bool fields; composition gates exact error type and both True. Cleanup result becomes True only after owning lock, successful group action or proven absent group, all acquired pipe closes, wait/reap. Ordinary failure/lock timeout/uncertain prior group action yields False; first non-Exception identity remains preserved.

currentCandidateSafety: Candidate C refuses unqualified startup exceptions and closes local capture; its positive fallback control injects a provisional mutable startup_cleanup_complete marker which the actual facade does not emit. This is not a demonstrated operational fallback.
positiveReview: Local run exists before remote startup.
Context/emit ordinary failure keeps local capture and retains the transport owner for final cleanup; loss stays unknown.
Caller closes DiagnosticRun without passing a business primary. Declared cancellation priority preserves winning object and does not set business cleanup_failed.
Closure fallback covers local close failure before the sink is called; common monotonic deadline is passed to the retained owner.
proposedSeamAssessment: Root successor plan is acceptable in principle: closed init-only dependency_admitted progress, at most once without extending startup deadline, prior to provider constructors; typed public startup failure carries two immutable booleans. Separate source/test review still required.
assuranceLimits: No source approval for complete operational composition yet.
Inert Popen/kill/FD/exchange ports expose actual source control flow; do not assert real process cleanup or installed missing-dependency behavior.
No complete C006, OTel transport, native query, publication/ACK or model-proof claim.
Original candidate/predecessor snapshots and raw controls are retained so subsequent root edits cannot erase these counterexamples.
